Pause screen: enters the menu display, pauses the sequence, shows the pause label until the start action button (action_button_masks[13]) is pressed, then resumes. No KF2 copy (KF2 has its CD-wait animation func_8001883c in this slot).
Root menu: player status + six-button page (USE ITEM, USE MAGIC, EQUIPMENT, STATUS/RECORDS, STORAGE, SYSTEM); R1+L1 shows the location number; a 0x1000-tagged result selects that spell.
Draws area*10000 + cell x*100 + cell z as a six-digit number.
USE ITEM list (items 95..149): map/note items open their picture, item 133 opens the warp map (result 150+n), consumables go through menu_apply_item_effect on exit.
Copies the name row, count and id of every item in [first,last] whose count in the given table is nonzero; returns the row count.
As menu_collect_masked_item_rows but subtracts one for each equipped slot holding the item (two for a doubly worn accessory) and skips items left at zero.
Rows for owned items whose guide level byte (item_guide_level[item]) is 5. "Locked" is a reading: 5 is above the player value (+0x4c) the guide compares against.
Applies a consumable (HP/MP restores, poison cure, status clears), clamps HP/MP, decrements the count (two potions also return item 118) and plays the item sound.
Clears paralysis and poison, caps slow at 64, then caps curse and darkness.
Caps the darkness value (+0x7e) at 64 and clears its limit (+0x80).
Caps the curse value (+0x7a) at 64 and clears its limit (+0x7c).
Loads the picture of a map/note item (ITEM entries 0x2f1..0x2f3) through the menu CD reader and shows it (item 95 in areas < 12 with the player marker) until a button is pressed.
Draws the loaded picture of item 95/99/other as an opaque and a translucent quad, shaded by brightness and the PANEL option.
Area map item (96): loads ITEM entry 721+area, reveals visited rects, draws them with the facing marker over a backdrop until a button is pressed.
Draws each of the area's 160 map rects whose revealed bit is set in map_revealed_rects[area].
Sets an area-map rect's revealed bit when any map cell inside it has its visited bit set (map_visited_cells).

SYSTEM page: load (-3 when loaded), the two option pages, button config, quit (-2: stops the CD and fades the music under PLEASE WAIT).

Starts a swing (hand 0/1) unless one is running, no weapon, or paralysed; fully-charged swings arm the weapon magic.
Magic origin in world space, the best entity in the view cone (stored as the view target, retargeted), and the scaled forward vector.
Per magic id: aims with player_probe_view_target_and_vectors and spawns the magic's Effect effects (boost magics also set their timers).
World position of a weapon model vertex at the current swing phase. Uncalled in GAME and FDAT (KF2's copy is called).
Whether the weapon magic of hand 0/1 may be used: it must be learned; six weapons always may, others need power and every magic value >= 50. KF2's checks only power/magic >= 60.
Uses a magic record when MP covers its cost (optionally paying it), sets the origin offset per id and calls player_dispatch_magic_effect.
Per-frame swing phase 0..4096: weapon magic, swing sound and hit probe along the swing; KF3 adds bows (arrow spend + aim).
Starts a magic: gear cost modifiers, MP and charge checks, per-id guards, then queues it with cast count, interval and origin offset.
Moves the player along a heading with collision retries (floor push, pushing objects, wall points, shorter steps, axis slides, slope slides); 1 when moved freely.
Falling at speed >= 400 more than 20480 above the floor starts death and sets the fatal-fall flag.
Landing sound 7, louder with the fall speed (from 320).
Fall states 0x10/0x20/0x40: steps, falls, landings (sound and fall damage), walking bob.
Moves the player along the reaction motion vector with gravity, sliding with friction on contact; 1 when it stops/lands.
Turn and look speeds from the pad into yaw and pitch, pitch clamped to +-700.
Walk and strafe speeds from the pad, then two player_move_horizontal calls along the yaw.
True for the item ids 104..120 that menu_apply_item_effect consumes (it rejects 110 and 113..118). KF2's slot tests a plain range.
Magic/item shortcut buttons, queued magic casts, a held button that lowers the damage scale and drains both charges, charge refill, the button sequence for weapon magic, and the attack button.
Springs the three reaction rotation offsets back to 0.
Renders one frame with two HUD options off, then releases the pool (before the menu opens).
Interact button dispatch; menu button opens menu_run_root_controller and acts on its result (use item, quit, reload after a load).
Reaction mode 0, walk speeds and all reaction/view offsets zeroed.
Reaction mode 8 with a movie id: the frame update steps the in-game movie player. KF2's mode follows a map object instead.
Reaction mode 7 with a movie id and the current angles: the frame update moves/turns the player to the movie's start pose, fades the music, then switches to mode 8.
Reaction mode 9 with a movie id and the current angles: the frame update moves/turns the player to the movie's end pose, fades the music back in, then resets the reaction. No KF2 copy.
Reaction mode 3 with the reaction vector (KF2's name; the mode moves the player along the vector via player_move_reaction_with_collision, as in KF2). Uncalled in GAME and FDAT.
initial static signature seed; requires call-site review
Reaction mode 0x10 (knocked back while moving): stores vector and rotation motion, red overlay, deep-fall state; KF3 skips it during movie modes 7..9.
Reaction mode 0x12 (rotation only): stores vector and rotation motion, red overlay; skipped during movie modes 7..9.
Reaction mode 0x11 once: death sound, optional knock vector, death frame counter 0.
From mode 0, reaction mode 5 (KF2 uses 4): the bobbing walk while overlapping an entity with flag 8.
Steps a status phase toward its limit (or down), returns it scaled over a duration, -1 when idle.
HP += delta clamped to max; 0 or less starts death.
Thin wrapper that only calls player_adjust_hp; its one caller heals 1..9 HP when weapon 0x1f hits. Role name from the single caller. No KF2 copy.
MP += delta clamped to 0..max.
Armour record HP regen/drain intervals against the tick counter.
Armour record MP regen/drain intervals against the tick counter (player_adjust_mp). KF3-only twin of the HP tick.

Steps darkness, the phase magic 29 starts (+0x8e, brighter fog), the red damage overlay and curse, setting fog/light and screen colour overlays (recalculates stats when curse ends). KF2 does this inline at the top of player_update_frame.

The player's frame: occupancy, visited cell, pad, speeds, the reaction-mode switch (normal, movie 7/8/9, knockback, bob, damage, death and respawn), status timers, view angle sums, weapon update and equipment ticks.
Selects the map cell under x/z and the layer suiting y (default cell outside the map); returns the layer's floor height.
The collision shape record interpreter: floors, ceilings, walls, corners, diagonals, stairs, ramps, ledges, layer switch; returns the hit bits. KF3 adds opcodes 0x17/0x24/0x25/0x33..0x35.
Samples the cell 1280 above, runs the shape records, returns the floor height.
Forces layer 0 or 1 (arg 2) of the cell at x/z, runs the shape records, returns the floor height.
Adds count*4 to the occupancy field of every map cell a circle touches.
Samples the cell half the body height above y, then runs the shape records; returns the hit bits.
Copies position, radius and height of what the last world query hit (player, entity or area object) into the collision cache.
World collision test by mask: shapes (+ pit flag), entities, area objects, the player; returns and caches the hit bits.
Empties both screen colour sums and turns the tint off. KF2 does this at the end of reset_collision_rows_and_overlay.
Copies the 64 area light records (light_default_records) into the working set and marks the turns for rebuilding. KF2 calls the same records "collision rows".
When flagged, rebuilds each working light record's three quarter-turned matrices.
Lerps the selected parts of one light record toward a target: two matrices, colour, fog near/far (kept 4096 apart).
Lerps the first 48 working light records toward a target; flags the turns when the matrix changes.
Lerps the light colour (unless 0xff) and fog near/far (unless 0xffff) of the light records toward the given values.
Walks the 25x25 view grid in ascending order (views facing +z) and clears the cells behind each wall cell, in the direction away from the viewer.
The same wall occlusion walk in descending order (views facing -z).

Builds the 25x25 map-cell visibility grid around the viewer from the yaw, pitch-widened view cone and range, applies wall occlusion and copies it to the render state. KF2 builds layer masks differently (build_camera_map_cell_layer_masks).
Returns a free VRAM scroll record (mode 0xff) of the two, or NULL.
Starts a VRAM scroll of a rect (delay, step, mode; mode 1 = 4-bit width), copying the area 32 pixels left as the source.
Steps the two VRAM scrolls: after each delay, advances the row offset and MoveImages the wrapped source rows.
Stores fog near/far; equal values turn fog off (near 0xffff); SetFogNear(near, 200). KF2's takes only the near distance.
GPU/GTE set-up, two draw/disp envs, back/far colour, fog, primitive pools, message queue, VRAM scrolls, tint off. KF3 inlines KF2's display_reset.
Flips the buffer index, selects the pool and both OTs, clears them, resets the counters.
DrawSync/VSync, puts the envs, links the overlay OT into the main OT and draws it.
Sets viewer position/angles (NULL keeps), view cell, the view rotation, its four quarter turns and the pitch matrix.

Walks every object's primitive packets of a TMD (object count at +8, prim offsets at +0x1c, stride 28) and turns the vertex/normal indices into byte offsets (<< 3) per packet kind; textured kinds also clear tpage bits 5-6. Body unclaimed (game-h/c/0x8003591c.txt).
Stores TMD data in slot id (scene_display_sys.unk10148[id]), makes it current (scene_display_sys.vertices) and prepares its primitive indices.
Stores TMD data in slot id without making it current or preparing it.
Draws TMD object id of the current model from the projected vertices: back faces culled, FT3/FT4/GT3/GT4 packets lit from their normals with depth cue, linked at average depth + depth bias.

Projects object id's vertices with fog, then hands each front face to the LIBGTE subdivision (RCpoly*), finer the nearer it is; faces with every vertex nearer than the clip depth are dropped. KF3-only (KF2's near path is its own clipper render_enqueue_tmd_with_clipping).
As render_enqueue_textured_tmd with every face semi-transparent in blend mode mode (tpage ABR bits = mode << 5).
render_enqueue_textured_tmd for render_distant_world_model: depth cue scaled down by (3 - shift); with shift set the faces go into the eight overlay OT entries (ot2) by depth / 2048. dist is unused.
Draws object id with NormalColorCol lighting (gte ncct/nccs), blend mode in the tpage (shade << 5), every front face linked into ot2 at one fixed depth.
Far map-layer renderer: projects the object's vertices with fog, draws front faces as Gouraud-textured packets (flat-textured records become GT3/GT4) lit from one normal and depth-cued per vertex.

Near map-layer renderer: projects like render_enqueue_map, then hands each front face to the LIBGTE subdivision, finer the nearer it is. Fills KF2's near path (render_enqueue_tmd_with_clipping) by a different method.

Draws one map-cell layer: light record turned by its quarter turns, fog, cell transform, then the near (flags bit 2, with packet space left) or far map renderer; skips objects past the limit during an area transition.
Draws the visible layers (flags bit 1) of map cell (x, z) through render_map_cell_object. Uncalled: render_map_cell_window carries an inlined copy.
Sets up the map model and packet pool in the scratchpad and draws the layers of every cell of the 25x25 view grid that has a mask.

Draws the visible 3D overlay rows of render_model_rows (KF3: the two compass styles) in view space: lit, scaled, posed by animation_prepare_asset_vertices, projected flat, drawn by render_enqueue_textured_tmd. Not KF2's render_player_weapon (that is render_player_weapon).
Fills a POLY_FT4 (corners, UV rect, tpage, CLUT, colour, optional semi-transparency) in the frame's buffer area and draws it at once with DrawPrim.

Draws the 200x200 texture at tpage 0x1f / CLUT 0x723c as a quad inset by inset pixels at grey level level. Only caller is the uncalled loading_screen_update_fade; same tpage/CLUT as loading_screen_show's picture.
Reads LOAD.MSG from the disc (up to 50 tries), uploads its TIMs, draws the picture and caption quads immediately and turns the display on; clears the fade counters.
Steps the loading-screen fade (scene_display_sys fade_level/fade_hold, cleared by loading_screen_show): flips buffers and redraws the picture at half the level each step. Uncalled.
Allocates a POLY_FT4 from the packet pool and fills corners, UV rect, tpage, CLUT and colour, optionally semi-transparent, linked at depth z.
Allocates a POLY_G4 from the packet pool with four corner colours and an optional semi-transparency mode, linked at depth z. Uncalled.
Allocates a DR_MODE + SPRT pair from the packet pool (position, UV, size, CLUT, colour, tpage via DR_MODE, optional semi-transparency), linked at depth z. Uncalled.

While the player's first clearance (+0x154, KF2 collision_lower_clearance) is under 240: a full-screen backdrop quad plus a semi-transparent panel from y = clearance + 120 down. KF3 adds the backdrop quad.
Semi-transparent full-width panel from y = second clearance (+0x158, KF2 collision_upper_clearance) + 120 down while it is under 240.
Same panel for the third clearance (+0x15c, KF3's third collision bound), another texture row. The name extends KF2's primary/secondary pair (a role name).
initial static signature seed; requires call-site review
Full-screen tint quad while the overlay mode is not 0xff: blend mode = mode & 3, colour from the tint record, depth 1 when mode bit 7 is set, else 0x40.
Sets the screen tint mode and colour.
Full-screen quad in the average colour of sum 0 (filled with which = 1, ABR 1 = additive) when it has samples.
Same for sum 1 (which = 2, ABR 2 = subtractive). KF2 has a single sum.
Adds (rgb * scale) >> 12 to colour sum which - 1 (1 additive, 2 subtractive) and counts the sample. KF3 adds the which selector.
Like accumulate_color_overlay but replaces colour sum which - 1 with (rgb * scale) >> 12 instead of adding (the sample count still goes up).

Saves the screen, then for 32 frames draws it as two quads whose corners move by step*4 / step*3 per frame while the colour brightens (step > 0) or darkens; restores the screen and the packet pools. Not KF2's menu_fade_transition (that is menu_fade_transition).

While the attack time (+0xc0) is not -1: lit by the map layer under the player, model 32 posed by animation_prepare_asset_vertices at the weapon record's offset/angle, projected with fog and drawn at depth bias 24.

Draws a model at pos/rotation/scale: light record of the layer under it, optionally blended toward a second, posed by animation, then the subdivided, blended or textured TMD renderer by flags; view == NULL transforms flat.

render_world_model for models whose translation can leave GTE range: skipped outside a wide angle around the player's heading, translation halved (view matrix scaled down to match) until under 0x8000, drawn by render_enqueue_distant_tmd.
Draws a model turned by rotation in view space (100 down), lit by light record light_id, posed by animation (base pose otherwise), projected and drawn by render_enqueue_tmd_fixed_depth.
Model registry index of an MapObject def: def + 256 below 300, else def + 256 + 32 * the area (the requested area while a transition loads it). KF2 adds 0x100 inline.
Returns model registry entry id through out; entries from 104 on only if their memory block is reclaimable or owned, else NULL.
CD read callback: prepares the loaded model's TMD primitive indices and marks its block owned.
Layer mask of the 25x25 view-grid cell under pos, 0 outside the grid.
OR of the view-grid masks in the square of radius cells around pos.
1 when the view cell lies within range_x / range_z cells of pos.
Allocates a block for archive entry (file, entry), tags it with registry id and queues its CD read with resource_tmd_read_complete.
For count sound banks: queues wanted ones that are not loaded, revives wanted released ones, marks unwanted loaded ones releasable (scratchpad wanted flags).
Same for count model registry entries: queues missing wanted models, keeps wanted ones owned, marks unwanted ones reclaimable.

Per-frame object pass: draws visible Actor actors, MapObject map objects (incl. the sound-by-distance kind 0x1f), Effect effects and the placed models, flagging the models / sound banks in use, then loads missing and releases unused ones.

Allocates DR_MODE + SPRT and fills it from a sprite record (position, UV, size, CLUT, depth) with colour rgb; mode != 0xff makes it semi-transparent with ABR mode & 3. Fills KF2's notification_draw_quad slot but serves the HUD too.
Draws each visible notification sprite (notification_quads) at the notification brightness: bit 1 additive, bit 2 subtractive, bit 4 subtractive at a quarter.
Draws every visible HUD sprite of hud_sprites (HP/MP gauges and digits, shown by the DISPLAY HP/MP option) at the player's brightness (+0xfd). KF2 drew its gauges as 3D model rows.
Queues notification message id (< 240) in the 8-slot ring if the head slot is free; id 25 also takes a number argument.
Sets a digit sprite's u to digit * 8 (KF2 sets v).
Notification state machine: takes the next queued message (id 25 shows a four-digit number), fades in by 20, holds 15 frames, fades out and drops repeats of the same id.

One game frame: view transform, VRAM scrolls, notifications, view grid, frame begin, pool marking, weapon, HUD/compass state from the options, overlays, map, objects, panels, colour overlays, present, frame gate, stale pool release.
Draws TMD slot 3 (the menu's item model) with the caller's matrices: projects with fog and draws object 0 at depth bias 100.
Makes model registry entry id's TMD current (scene_display_sys.vertices = file + its TMD offset).
Registers each entry (size >= 5) of a model archive from first id on and prepares its TMD.
Registers one model file at id and prepares its TMD.
Finds the key frame of animation anim that contains time; returns it with its index and the Q12 blend fraction (reversed frames count down).
Builds a pose from base vertices and a sparse delta list (runs of unchanged vertices copied from base).
Overwrites the vertices named by a sparse delta list (runs skip vertices).
Moves the vertices named by a sparse list toward its targets by blend fraction t (three at a time through ScaleMatrix).
Pointer to vertex index's entry in a sparse delta list, NULL when the list leaves it unchanged.

Poses model id for (anim, time) into the shared pose buffer through the owner's pool record (allocated or reused, decoded key frame cached); returns 1 for an unanimated model, 0 when no record is free, else the record.
One vertex of model id at (anim, time) without a pool record (static part for anim >= 128); returns 1 (vertex zeroed) when the model is not loaded.
Vertex count of model id's object 0, or of object part & 0x7f for part >= 128; 0 when not loaded. Uncalled.
Frees all 12 animation pool records without releasing memory.
Marks every live animation pool record stale (state 1) for this frame.
Frees one pool record: clears its owner's pointer and frees its pose.
Releases every live pool record.
Releases the pool records not used this frame (still state 1).
Returns the first free pool record (anim reset to 0xff) through out, or NULL.
Expands the area's placed-model table into the 128 records of map_placed_entries: cell + offset position, height from the map layer, random start frame.
Uploads every TIM (pixels, then CLUT) of a loaded file to VRAM.

Fades a full-screen picture over the saved screen by step per frame from level; returns the level when a button is pressed after a release, -1 / -2 otherwise. KF3 also records the action button bit (+0x178).
Loads TIM entry (file, entry), saves the screen, fades the picture in, waits for a press, fades it out and restores the screen and packet pools.
Writes a pattern variant's layer bytes into the map cells around (x, z) turned by angle (own / other layer by area; 0xfc / 0xff skip), optionally replacing the lighting flags.
Copies a w x h block of map cells to a destination turned by quarter turns; mask picks the layer-1 fields copied.
Plays sound effect se at the map object's position (range 120).
Frees all 396 map objects and zeroes the three spawn-pool sequence counters.
Resets a map object's animation, scale, rotation, action and lighting fields.
Varargs property setter for map object id by its def type: 0 clears layer / state, 1 sets the layer byte, 2 arms its event byte, 3 sets the depth offset.
Writes value (or 0xfc) into the object byte of the map-cell layer under the object and hides (scale 0) or shows it.
Re-applies the cell markers of actions 0x51, 0x52 and 7 (7 also passes mode to its linked object) for mode. Uncalled in KF3.

Builds the area's 350 placed map objects from the placement table (def, cell position, height, occupancy radius) and sets each def type's action and initial state (cell copies, patterns); unknown types go to FDAT handler 8.
Index of the first live map object (not the current one) whose radius or rotated box touches the point, -1 for none. KF3 adds the box test.
Index of the first map object from start that the point touches and that faces it within the angle tolerance; door types are probed ahead along their yaw.
Gives an idle map object (action 0xff) the action and resets its timer.
A free record among count from first, else the one with the oldest spawn sequence (when sequence != -1), else NULL.
Spawns a map object of def def_id at pos + dy in the placement (370) or definition (360) pool, random yaw, starting the fall / bounce action of its kind.

Spawns the def 0x95 gold pickup holding gold_amount (arg.h.unk3a; event_map_object_interact adds it to the player's gold) 600 units from pos in a random direction (pool at 350) and starts its bounce. KF2 calls it map_object_spawn_scattered_effect.
Passes marker / switch id to every map object whose action listens for it (clears, toggles or triggers it; door pairs use ids 150..198).
Tests one map object against marker id: 1 consumed, 2 already cleared, 3 mismatch, 4 refusing kinds, 0 not applicable.
map_object_check_and_consume_marker for every map object.
World position of a vertex of the map object's posed model (scaled, turned, translated).
1 when the player is in the map-cell rectangle (x, z, w, h) and, unless y is 0x8000, within 2048 above / 3200 below y.
Moves target from offset from to offset to of source over steps calls (the first call resets it to action 0x70), optionally fading it in; 1 on the last step.
Renders frames while stepping the colour-overlay level from phase to last by step (level^2 >> 16, capped at 255).
Moves the player, the Effect effects (except mode 0xc) and the Actor actors by (dx, dy, dz); a subset of translate_active_world_positions.

Direction from to (+1600 up) toward from, yaw pulled toward the object's facing by rate, pitch fixed unless -1, scaled by dist into out; count > 1 repeats with from advanced along the player's +0x11c vector. Returns the yaw.
Steps every live map object by its action (doors, lifts, levers, switches, warps, falling items); actions without a case go to FDAT handler 9.
First free Actor among the last ten (190..199), else NULL.
Places the actor at its home cell + offsets on the map layer floor (flag 0x400: collision cache height; flag 0x10 skips the anchor offset).
Copies definition id, HP, collision radius/height, flags and model scale from its ActorGroup definition.
Copies the defaults, sets lifecycle 1 (active), clears animation/target/motion, random yaw unless placement bit 0, lighting and render mode, adds map occupancy.
Lifecycle 3 (KF2 DISABLED), then actor_set_home_position.
For every persistent active actor running target type 3 in action state 0xf0 that has finished (+0x70 set or phase > 0x800): FDAT slot 19, then disable at home.
Clears pitch/roll, home layer and yaw, places it at home and initialises it; slot state 3 (homebound) gets map layer 0.
actor_prepare_and_initialize on actor[index]. Uncalled (no jal or data word in GAME.EXE or FDAT_*.BIN).
Frees all 200 actors (slot 0xff, lifecycle 0, animation cache NULL) and clears the frame counter and overlap-exclusion flags.
Remembers the previous target type and starts target record (KF3 WIP: script record) target, or clears it (type/state 0xff).
Scores one target record for the current actor at player distance (per-type range/cone/chance tests, FDAT slot 16 for map-defined types). Unclaimed body (asm only).
Scores the definition's up to 16 target records and sets the best unless the action state is 0xf0 or 0.
actor_select_best_target with the XZ distance from the current actor to the player.
First target record of the definition whose type byte is id, else NULL.
actor_set_target with the target record of type id from the actor's own definition.
Marks the current actor's target unselected (0xff) and reselects by player distance.
Sets the current actor's animation (0xff: none) and phase 0; KF3 adds 2 to the clip for the actor in actor_animation_shift_target while actor_animation_shift_enabled is set.
As actor_set_animation, only when the clip differs (same +2 rule).
Wakes dormant actors in range (spawn chance, overlap test, entry target types 0x15/6/0x1a), returns active/blocked ones home when the player is out of range.
Every live actor of definition kind: active ones switch to target type 3, others are disabled at home. Uncalled.
Damage curve of one attack component against a resistance (KF2 formula).
Applies an 8-component attack to actor index: resistances, FDAT slot 18 adjust, training/experience, hurt or death target, knock-back from position.
actor_apply_magic_to_actor on every active actor within reach of a point, scaled by falloff.
Damages the player when within range and the actor's facing cone; returns 1 on a hit.
Active actor best inside the yaw/pitch cone from a point (lowest angle + distance score, optional jitter); distance out.
Index of the first active actor (not target type 3, not excluded, not current) whose body holds the point, else -1. KF3 adds the vertex-anchored case (flag 0x400000).
As actor_find_overlap_excluding_target_type3 without the type-3 test; KF3 instead skips definition 0x6e.
Sets the current actor, its definition and index, and the linked actor/definition when flag 0x10; NULL clears them.
Advances the animation phase by delta, wrapping at 0x1000; stores |delta| as the step.
Advances the animation phase by delta, clamped to 0..0xfff.
Whether the last animation step passed phase.
Moves the current actor by motion XZ, sliding on walls and corners and stopping at drops per the move flags; returns hit bits.
Moves the current actor by motion in 3D; on a hit reverses the blocked component.
Solves a jump to a target and enters vertical state 0x30; returns the travel time or -1.
Vertical motion state 0x60 (suspended).
Falls, lands, rises and runs the ballistic jump of the current actor; fall damage to the player on landing on them.
On the ground, decays horizontal motion by decay, then actor_move_horizontal_with_collision.
Accelerates motion toward speed along the heading, then moves with collision.
initial static signature seed; requires call-site review
initial static signature seed; requires call-site review
Turns the actor toward a yaw with an accelerating turn rate (+0x58), clamped so it does not overshoot.
actor_turn_toward_angle then actor_move_along_heading with the new yaw.
Turns and moves toward (x, z); -1 when close and outside the reference-angle cone; returns the heading.
Accelerates along pitch/yaw in 3D, moves horizontally with collision and vertically if clear; result bits 1 horizontal, 2 vertical blocked.
Turns yaw and pitch toward the angles, then actor_move_along_euler_angles.
Animated model vertex of the actor, scaled and rotated (yaw + half turn); a default point when the sample fails.
Aim point of the actor by flags & 3: position, position + definition offset, or rotated offset.
Picks idle/turn-left/turn-right/climb/descend clips from turn rate and vertical motion and advances them.
Aim direction from origin at a target, limited by yaw rate and refined over iterations leading the player's motion; returns the yaw.
Fires effect kind from a model vertex / rotated offset / between two vertices of the current actor, aimed at the player (varargs).
Pitch offset for the actor's sounds from its scale, clamped +-12, plus noise.
Plays the running target record's sound (byte 4 + 240) at the actor.
Runs one frame of the current actor's target behaviour by target type (FDAT slot 17 for unknown types): sound, movement, attacks.
Per-frame loop over all actors: bind, lifecycle every 4th frame, target pick, behaviour, attachment to an MapObject.
Turns the loaded definitions' target-record offsets into pointers (-1: NULL).
Fills the 200 actors from an area's placement records, dormant, with defaults and home position.
Plays a sound at the effect record (volume 110, KF2 ranges).
Collision query for the current effect at a point with a mask by its target type; counts down its cooldown first.
Hit result 0x80: player_apply_damage; 0x10: facing test then actor_apply_magic_to_actor on the cached actor.
Power of the current effect: KF3 averages the player stats at +0x42.. picked by the magic record's element bits (type flag 0x40), else 5. KF2 returns the player's magic stat.
effect_dispatch_magic_impact with the current effect and its magic record.
effect_apply_current_magic from 8 motion steps back, radius 5000.
Area hit of the current effect on the player (type bit 0) and the actors (bit 1).
Model vertex of the effect, scaled and rotated (yaw + half turn).
effect_sample_rotated_vertex plus the effect position.
First free of the 128 effect records, else NULL.
KF3-only sibling of effect_pool_initialize_scaled: render flags 1 (visible, world transform; KF2 enum), lighting 0x34, render id, queue mode and uniform scale.
Render flags 5 (visible + identity transform), lighting 0x33 (KF2 0x43 scaled effect), render id, queue mode and uniform scale.
Screen-space effect at (160, y + 120) with pitch, flags 0xe, lighting 0x34, scale 0x100.
Makes an effect record of a kind from a free slot (type flags, position, motion, per-kind set-up and varargs payload); NULL when none is free.
Scales an offset's X/Z and rotates it by a yaw (RotMatrix/ApplyMatrix). Uncalled.
Accelerates the current effect, caps its speed, moves it and probes collision (-1 on a hit).
Homing: turns toward the best actor in cone (player magic) or the player, then effect_move_probe.
Steers straight at a target, braking inside the settle distance; -2 on arrival.
Grows the effect, applies radial damage over the grown shell, frees it at the limit.
Spawns effect kind 0x6e at a model vertex with zero motion and a jittered yaw.
Spawns effect kind 0x70 on the floor below a point within a height window; 1 if spawned.
Spawns effect kind 0x6f at a vertex with motion by mode (vertex, random ranges, zero, backward) plus inherited motion.
Spawns count kind-0x70 effects scattered on the floor around a point.
Moves the current effect one step and probes (also half a step back for fast effects), sets its map layer and spins it.
Moves the current effect one motion step back. KF2's version also undoes the midpoint step; KF3 splits that into effect_collision_backtrack_half.
Moves the current effect half a motion step back. KF3-only.
Per-frame update of the current effect by its kind (movement, hits, trails).
Frees all 128 effect records.
Copies the 96 magic records (0x900 bytes) into effect_status. Uncalled.
Per frame: for each live effect, bind it and its magic record, count down its life (free at -1) or run effect_update_dispatch.
